rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for attracting someone's attention or interest.

example.english: This movie sparked my interest from the very beginning.
example.traditional: 呢套戲一開場就吸引咗我。
example.jyutping: nei1 tou3 hei3 jat1 hoi1 coeng4 zau6 kap1 jan5 zo2 ngo5

rows.note: Use this construction when explicitly saying that something makes a particular person interested in an activity or topic.

example.english: This workshop sparked my interest in pottery.
example.traditional: 呢個工作坊令我有興趣學陶藝。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 gung1 zok3 fong1 ling6 ngo5 jau5 hing3 ceoi3 hok6 tou4 ngai6

rows.note: Use this when focusing on arousing or stimulating interest rather than simply attracting attention.

example.english: This movie managed to interest me.
example.traditional: 呢套戲引起咗我嘅興趣。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 jan5 hei2 zo2 ngo5 ge3 hing3 ceoi3

rows.note: For personal curiosity or hobbies, 興趣 is the all-purpose choice.

example.english: I have a lot of interest in photography.
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 jing2 soeng2 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3

rows.note: Use 利息 for money charged or earned on a loan or deposit.

example.english: How much interest does this fixed deposit earn?
example.traditional: 呢筆定期有幾多利息呀？
example.jyutping: ni1 bat1 ding6 kei4 jau5 gei2 do1 lei6 sik1 aa3

rows.note: Use 注意 for attention that someone gives to or receives from a person or thing.

example.english: Everyone showed great interest in the report during the meeting.
example.traditional: 開會嗰陣，大家都好注意個報告。
example.jyutping: hoi1 wui6 go2 zan6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 zyu3 ji3 go3 bou3 gou3

rows.note: Use 利益 for a financial or business stake or benefit, rather than personal curiosity or attention.

example.english: This deal serves the interest of both sides.
example.traditional: 呢項交易符合雙方利益。
example.jyutping: ni1 hong6 gaau1 jik6 fu4 hap6 soeng1 fong1 lei6 jik1
